newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse falls for 4th successive week.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse falls for 4th successive week.

text.p: The Abidjan Stock Exchange (BVA) extended its downward trend for a fourth week during slow Christmas trading, according to its weekly report.
With shipping company SIVOM making its market debut and UNIWAX distributing an 8,800 CFA franc dividend, the BVA All-Share Index fell in the week to Friday by 1.27 percent to 358.94 points.
The 12VB blue chip index fell 1.2 percent to 242.73.
Volume fell again with 1,774 shares changing hands compared with 2,588 the previous week.
Among individual stocks, the main fallers were UNIWAX (-8,800 CFA to 53,110 CFA) and tobacco company SITAB (-3,550 CFA to 43,450).
Diversified company Blohorn (+1,580 CFA to 40,310) led the risers followed by ELF OIL-CI (+1,440 CFA to 30,390) and sack maker FILTISAC (+1,180 to 44,600).
SIVOM was unchanged at its opening price of 12,000 CFA.
The All-Share Index has risen 29.46 percent in 1996, the 12VB index has risen 21.82 percent.
